$comment: Generated by tools/genreport/generate.py from datasets.openapi.yaml of github.com/ncbi/datasets (commit 488962028aab2a1bab244dd35def300783cebf69, sha256 353e226daee7425064f7ee2267079d591ad36e8c0cef1b86b433ece08ed6f840). Derived from NCBI's OpenAPI definition; not an official NCBI schema. Additions to the source definition: uint64 strings carry the pattern ^[0-9]+$, and the root declares an optional "$schema" property.
title: AssemblyDataReport
description: NCBI Datasets genome assembly data report (snake_case names, as returned by the REST API and `datasets summary`). One record per genome assembly.

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema this record conforms to. Written by the ncbigenome Go library when it marshals a report; not part of NCBI's report definition.

current_accession.title: The latest GenColl assembly accession for this revision chain

paired_accession.title: The GenBank or RefSeq assembly accession paired with this assembly

source_database.title: Source of the accession. The paired accession, if it exists, is from the other database.

assembly_info.title: Metadata for the genome assembly submission

assembly_stats.title: Global statistics for the genome assembly

annotation_info.title: Metadata and statistics for the genome assembly annotation, when available

wgs_info.title: Metadata pertaining to the Whole Genome Shotgun (WGS) record for the genome assemblies  that are complete genomes. Those that are clone-based do not have WGS-master records.

checkm_info.title: Metadata on the completeness and contamination of this assembly

assembly.title: Accession of the submitted organism best match type-strain assembly or best match type-strain assembly

organism_name.title: Taxonomic name of the submitted organism or best match type-strain organism

assembly_coverage.title: Percent coverage of the query assembly by the submitted organism or best match type assembly

type_assembly_coverage.title: Percent coverage of the submitted organism or best match type assembly by the query assembly

method.title: Software tools used to calculate annotation

pipeline.title: NCBI annotation pipeline used to calculate annotation

assembly_level.title: The level at which a genome has been assembled

paired_assembly.title: Metadata from the GenBank or RefSeq assembly paired with this one

assembly_name.title: The assembly submitter's name for the genome assembly, when provided. Otherwise, a default name in the  form ASM#####v# is assigned

assembly_type.title: Chromosome content of the submitted genome assembly

submission_date.title: Date the assembly was submitted to NCBI (being replaced by release date - should maintain until most CLI users upgrade)

release_date.title: Date the assembly was made available by NCBI. This field is not returned by versions of the datasets Command Line Interface (CLI) program < 15.

submitter.title: The submitting consortium or organization. Full submitter information is available in the BioProject

refseq_category.title: The RefSeq Category, if present, indicates whether the assembly is a reference genome

synonym.title: Genome name ascribed to this assembly by the UC Santa Cruz genome browser

linked_assembly.title: The accession.version and designation (principal or alternate pseudohaplotype) of a paired genome assembly derived from the same diploid individual

atypical.title: Information on atypical genomes - genomes that have assembly issues or are otherwise atypical

sequencing_tech.title: Sequencing technology used to sequence this genome

grouping_method.title: Version of the NCBI Virus segmented genome grouping pipeline, which groups  nucleotide sequences for segmented viruses into a single genome assembly. For more  information, see the [NCBI Virus Help Documentation](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/labs/virus/vssi/docs/help/#virus_segment_grouping)

biosample.title: NCBI BioSample from which the sequences in the genome assembly were obtained.

blast_url.title: URL to blast page for this assembly

suppression_reason.title: The reason for the assembly is suppressed, for suppressed assemblies

total_number_of_chromosomes.title: Count of nuclear chromosomes, organelles and plasmids in a submitted genome assembly

total_sequence_length.title: Total sequence length of the nuclear genome including unplaced and unlocalized sequences

total_ungapped_length.title: Total length of all top-level sequences ignoring gaps. Any stretch of 10 or more Ns in a sequence is treated like a gap

number_of_contigs.title: Total number of sequence contigs in the assembly. Any stretch of 10 or more Ns in a sequence is treated as a gap between two  contigs in a scaffold when counting contigs and calculating contig N50 & L50 values

contig_n50.title: Length such that sequence contigs of this length or longer include half the bases of the assembly

contig_l50.title: Number of sequence contigs that are longer than, or equal to, the N50 length and therefore include half the bases of the assembly

number_of_scaffolds.title: Number of scaffolds including placed, unlocalized, unplaced, alternate loci and patch scaffolds

scaffold_n50.title: Length such that scaffolds of this length or longer include half the bases of the assembly

scaffold_l50.title: Number of scaffolds that are longer than, or equal to, the N50 length and therefore include half the bases of the assembly

gaps_between_scaffolds_count.title: Number of unspanned gaps between scaffolds

number_of_component_sequences.title: Total number of component WGS or clone sequences in the assembly

atgc_count.title: The number of AT and GC base-pairs in the assembly

gc_count.title: The number of GC base-pairs in the assembly

gc_percent.title: The percentage of GC base-pairs in the assembly, rounded to the nearest 0.5%

is_atypical.title: If true there are assembly issues or the assembly is in some way non-standard

taxonomy_check_status.title: Indicates whether the ANI result is consistent with the submitted organism

match_status.title: Indicates the specific type of ANI result that supports the Taxonomy check status

submitted_organism.title: Taxonomic name of the query assembly

submitted_species.title: Species name of the query assembly

category.title: Category of type or validated assembly

comment.title: Additional information about the ANI result

title.title: Title of the BioProject provided by the submitter

age.title: Age at the time of sampling

biomaterial_provider.title: Name and address of the lab or PI

collected_by.title: Name of persons or institute who collected the sample

collection_date.title: Date on which the sample was collected

dev_stage.title: Developmental stage at the time of sampling

ecotype.title: Population within a given species adapted to a local habitat

host.title: The natural host to the organism

identified_by.title: Name of the taxonomist who identified the specimen

ifsac_category.title: Interagency Food Safety Analytics Collaboration (IFSAC) category

isolate.title: Description of the specific individual from which the sample was derived

isolate_name_alias.title: Other IDs associated with this isolate

lat_lon.title: Geographic coordinates of the location where the sample was collected

serovar.title: Taxonomic name below subspecies. Same as serotype.

source_type.title: Controlled vocabulary describing the isolation source

tissue.title: Type of tissue from which the sample was derived

serotype.title: Taxonomic name below subspecies. Same as serovar

checkm_marker_set.title: What taxonomic group is used as the basis for comparison with this assembly with regards to checkM values

checkm_species_tax_id.title: The species-level taxid for this assemblies checkM dataset

completeness.title: What percent complete is this assembly

contamination.title: What is the contamination percentage for this assembly

completeness_percentile.title: The percent of assemblies under the taxonomic grouping 'checkm_marker_set' that this assembly is as-or-more complete than.

protein_coding.title: Count of annotated genes that encode a protein

non_coding.title: Count of transcribed non-coding genes (e.g. lncRNAs, miRNAs, rRNAs, etc...) excludes transcribed pseudogenes

pseudogene.title: Count of transcribed and non-transcribed pseudogenes

other.title: Count of genic region GeneIDs and non-genic regulatory GeneIDs

breed.title: A homogenous group of animals within a domesticated species

cultivar.title: A variety of plant within a species produced and maintained by cultivation

ecotype.title: A population or subspecies occupying a distinct habitat

isolate.title: The individual isolate from which the sequences in the genome assembly were derived

strain.title: A genetic variant, subtype or culture within a species

infraspecific_name.title: The strain, breed, cultivar or ecotype of the organism from which the sequences in the assembly were derived

description.title: Long description of the organelle genome

total_seq_length.title: Sequence length of the organelle genome

accession.title: The GenColl assembly accession of the GenBank or RefSeq assembly paired with this one

status.title: GenColl Assembly status from paired record

only_genbank.title: Sequences that are only included in the GenBank assembly

only_refseq.title: Sequences that are only included in the RefSeq assembly

changed.title: Sequences present on both the GenBank and the RefSeq assemblies that have been changed, e.g., contaminated sequence in the GenBank assembly has been replaced with a gap

manual_diff.title: Manually curated description of differences between the GenBank and RefSeq assemblies

refseq_genbank_are_different.title: boolean indication on whether there are any differences between the GenBank and RefSeq assemblies

differences.title: Concatenation of all differences between the GenBank and RefSeq assemblies, including manually curated description and other fields

wgs_contigs_url.title: WGS project Sequence set browser web address
